latest_release.name: gVisor 20261109.0
latest_release.body:
## gVisor release 20261109.0

Binaries are also available from the apt repository and the release bucket;
see [Installation](https://gvisor.dev/docs/user_guide/install/).

### Changes since `release-20261102.0`

```text
Support UDP in netgofer. (c58baea46)
Clear the interrupt shadow before delivering memory-fault signals. (abeb5cfca)
Refresh gvisor website to include sandboxing messaging. (70d4d07f0)
Add dedicated overlayfs syscall test suite (5aca3eeb3)
Update agents guidance. (39e515be5)
buildkite coordinator: delete instances that never got a timeout (eda4531ce)
nvproxy: don't copy non-parent dependencies in objDup (49e0b1ad5)
build(deps): bump actions/checkout from 5.1.0 to 7.0.1 (b3095be6a)
overlay: add lockdep subclasses for stacked overlays and directory copy-up (87f30ad81)
Round the minimum user address up to a page boundary. (e3550d8a2)
Mark nybidari as being on hiatus. (5999b18ff)
Release waiters and page references after a checkpoint read error (f054d1f11)
Export the netgofer command to the Go branch (bf7b1290b)
Preserve packet headers when consuming payloads (5053feec2)
Remove unused receive dispatcher GRO state (7321ca09d)
Preserve Bazel errors in the Gazelle check (c036b7338)
Start netgofer proxy in runsc. (451b92800)
Report retransmitted segments in TCP_INFO (7eda82e34)
Prepare more code for a runtime page size on arm64. (ed70698a7)
Build the Python HTTP image with rules_img (e62c22929)
Run the issue reviver without the Docker builder (3f9a9984a)
Build the resolver-symlink image with Bazel (a869d645a)
.github: let repo-guarded workflows run in gvisor/gvisor too (9f44ec755)
buildkite coordinator: apply idle timeouts to all agents (53788c741)
Recognize instantiated method receivers in stateify (1de5b54a9)
pgalloc: handle host faults when zeroing disk-backed pages (2b39184b6)
Serve the InfiniBand port P_Key table in the RDMA sysfs tree. (f5a077d07)
Require CAP_SYS_ADMIN for clone(CLONE_NEWNS) (bf8486ad1)
tcp: fix lost wakeups in two listen tests (3030bcb89)
Check the mutex protecting TCP keepalive options and probe counts (902bee917)
proc: add /proc/sys/fs/aio-max-nr and aio-nr (45a446ab1)
nvproxy: Use Syscall for host driver ioctls. (bbbd1d891)
runsc: introduce programmatic Go client with pause, resume, and state (77b464738)
Identify fdnotifier events by registration (9f4158394)
fix(tmpfs): read SourceTar to EOF after restoring a tar archive (0e2cd7793)
Declare vDSO disassembly tools (8f985c75c)
Run command lifecycle tests without /bin/sleep (b41ed9e0e)
Use the test binary for specutils child processes (18eea6dde)
Check the locks protecting kernfs directory children (199cf1558)
Remove the unused inotify Watch.OwnerID method (3cc383db9)
runsc: ignore tmpfs size= in mount options annotations on restore (94c03f66c)
netstack: fix bubblewrap: add if up/down, add lo address on if up, remove ipv6 on if down (80f80e7ae)
cpuid: make arm64 /proc/cpuinfo Features match AT_HWCAP (095ec5f25)
Check the instance lock when changing inotify watch indexes (738ede495)
buildkite: remove "Build runsc and pkg" step from First Pass pipeline (fd48fa491)
buildkite coordinator: implement idle timeouts for pinned agents (ca71e3bb6)
overlay: Rename on the upper layer with the filesystem's credentials. (06dda0dfe)
vfs: preserve empty mount tables across restore (4093ee5fe)
Use the timer helper for negative intervals (626ca2e77)
Preserve XML test suites during collation (1cbd8021a)
Check locking on pipe ring buffer operations (ef2403a1d)
Compare RACK timestamps across a clock wrap (33a1870df)
Check the mutexes required by the timekeeper updater (b40bb52d4)
overlay: check the file cache mutex (05eca6e0c)
Stage release binaries with a declared copy tool (83634be8c)
Report negotiated timestamps and SACK in TCP_INFO (70e7896ac)
Use the configured MTU for veth and loopback (679d20c1b)
Allow Bazel to sandbox Nogo filtering and facts rendering (021ba8c34)
Keep the x86 vDSO gettimeofday alias independent of libc headers (cf2264788)
Exclude AMX TILEDAT
